data.one_liner: A customizable application menu bar widget with submenus for Flutter desktop apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a menu bar widget for Flutter desktop applications that supports nested submenus, dividers, icons, keyboard shortcuts, and full customization via standard Flutter styles.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application and need a traditional application menu bar.
You want customizable menus with shortcuts, icons, and submenus rendered inside the app.
avoid_when: You need native operating system menu bars (the package currently renders inside the Flutter app).
You are building a mobile-only application.
strengths: Supports nested submenus, dividers, and icons.
Keyboard shortcuts and shortcut text support.
Fully customizable using standard Flutter MenuStyle and ButtonStyle classes.
weaknesses: Rendered inside the Flutter app rather than as a native desktop menu bar.
